question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that reality in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation is that reality.
Its range extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: One should meditate on that reality in every place as pervading all levels from Shiva to Avici.
